title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
summary: New research shows the most advanced AI models from China were trained on banned Nvidia chips.
llm_summary: New research reveals that China’s most sophisticated AI models were trained using Nvidia GPUs that are subject to U.S. export bans, meaning the chips were obtained despite restrictions. The findings highlight how Chinese firms have managed to access high‑performance hardware to power cutting‑edge AI, raising concerns about the effectiveness of current export‑control measures.
